Self.Wiki: A trigger area for event scripts. In AC6 this type has nothing to do with invasions: FromSoftware names these regions 'intrusion check' (侵入判定), and the map's events use them to react when the player's AC enters or leaves a place, for example to start a radio conversation, start an enemy patrol, switch a turret on or decide whether a target is in firing range. The game has no code of its own for this type: it is only found through its Entity ID or Entity ID Group, by event conditions such as IF In/Outside Area (3[2]), and Change Area Enable State (2003[1008]) can switch it off. Any region type with an Entity ID can be used the same way. Retail: 51 regions in 6 m01 mission maps (m01_00_70, m01_00_80, m01_04_60, m01_06_20, m01_06_30, m01_06_40); 38 are used by the map's events.

Shape.Wiki: The area the event checks. A character counts as inside when its position is inside this shape. Retail: 46 Boxes and 5 Cylinders, from about 40 units across to nearly 10,000. A Point shape has no inside, so it never triggers.

Position.Wiki: Where the trigger area is placed.

Rotation.Wiki: Turns the trigger area, in degrees. The inside test uses the turned shape.

RegionID.Wiki: The region's ID. The game keeps every region of the map in a table keyed by it, so keep it different from the map's other regions. Event scripts do not use it: they use the Entity ID.

EntityID.Wiki: How event scripts find the area. Use it in IF In/Outside Area (3[2]) to wait for a character to enter or leave, or in Change Area Enable State (2003[1008]) to switch the area off and on. While the area is switched off, neither 'inside' nor 'outside' is true, so a waiting condition does not pass. Leave it at 0 when the area is only found through an Entity ID Group. Retail: map-local IDs 2000 to 2930 on 41 regions; 2 regions have neither an ID nor a group, so no event can reach them.

EntityGroupIDs.Wiki: Lets one event condition check several areas at once: IF In/Outside Area (3[2]) with a group ID is true when the character is inside any area of the group. Only the first slot is used in retail. Retail: groups 7300 to 7317 on 11 regions, in m01_00_70, m01_00_80 and m01_06_40.

ChildRegionNames.Wiki: No effect for this region type. Retail: empty.

ActivationPartName.Wiki: No effect for this region type: the event area check does not test it. Retail: empty.

UnkC08.Wiki: No effect for this region type. Retail: -1.
